about.title: About ZTF University Institute
about.mission: To provide faith-integrated, academically excellent education that empowers students to become innovative leaders who serve God, Africa, and the world.
about.vision: To be the leading Christian university in Central Africa, producing graduates who combine biblical values, professional excellence, and a heart for service.
about.founder_bio: Professor Zacharias Tanee Fomum (1945–2009) was one of Africa's greatest academic minds and spiritual leaders. He earned a first-class B.Sc. from Fourah Bay College (1969), a Ph.D. in Organic Chemistry from the University of Makerere, Uganda (at age 28), and a Doctor of Science from Durham University, Great Britain (2005) — one of the highest academic distinctions in the world. As Professor of Organic Chemistry at the University of Yaoundé I, he supervised over 100 doctoral and master's theses and co-authored more than 160 publications in top international journals, ranking his department second among all African scientific research centres in 2004. He was also the founder of Christian Missionary Fellowship International, with churches in over 130 countries, and authored more than 350 books with 10 million copies in 100+ languages.
about.history: ZTF University Institute was established in 2023 in Bertoua, Cameroon — the very land where Prof. ZTF lived and served. Built on the legacy of a man who believed education was an act of obedience to God, ZTF-UI seeks to raise the next generation of African scholars, professionals, and leaders who will transform the continent and the world.
